description: hugoh/hk-config//renovate.json is extended here so every consumer gets its custom managers (the hugoh/hk-config and jdx/hk pins in *.pkl / mise.toml) and its global disable of the built-in mise manager for `hk`. Repos with no hk.pkl are unaffected — those managers just match nothing. Since ~every repo uses hk.pkl, this is injected in the base rather than opted into per repo.

packageRules.description: config:best-practices pulls in security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm, whose packageRule lowers npm to 3 days and would otherwise override the top-level 7 days.

My own packages (actions, reusable workflows, spoons, ...) don't need the 7-day soak meant for third-party supply-chain risk: 1 day is enough to catch a bad release. Must stay above the first-party gh-workflows rule below so its 12-hour override still wins in the repos it covers.

First-party reusable workflows and composite actions: a bump only reaches consumers once a new tag is cut, so propagate within a day and automerge. Restricted to the repos that own these workflows/actions. Needs its own groupName so it isn't swallowed into the "minor updates"/"patch updates" groups above, which would otherwise pull in their monthly/weekly schedules instead of "at any time".

Single owner of the hk toolchain grouping: the jdx/hk and hugoh/hk-config pins (custom managers from hugoh/hk-config//renovate.json, which only reads the pins) move in ONE PR, so the Pkl schema pin, the CLI pin in mise.toml and the base.pkl they were validated against never drift. Must stay BELOW the generic minor/patch grouping rules above, or their groupName replaces this one (later packageRules win); scripts/check-hk-grouping.mjs enforces it. 1-day minimumReleaseAge instead of the 7-day third-party soak, so jdx/hk doesn't age past a fresh hk-config release and split the group.
